panels.title: LLM calls / interval
panels.description: LiteLLM completions traced via OTLP into Langfuse (gen_ai spans, type=GENERATION).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, count() AS "LLM calls" FROM events_full WHERE type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name NOT IN ('', 'mcp-tool-call') AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, concat(provided_model_name, ' p95') AS metric, quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)) AS value FROM events_full WHERE type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name NOT IN ('', 'mcp-tool-call') AND isNotNull(end_time) AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, concat(provided_model_name, ' p50') AS metric, quantile(0.50)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)) AS value FROM events_full WHERE type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name NOT IN ('', 'mcp-tool-call') AND isNotNull(end_time) AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time
SELECT round(sum(total_cost), 4) AS "USD" FROM events_full WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT count() AS "errors" FROM events_full WHERE level = 'ERROR' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)

SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, 'input' AS metric, sum(usage_details['input']) AS value FROM events_full WHERE type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name NOT IN ('', 'mcp-tool-call') AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, 'output' AS metric, sum(usage_details['output']) AS value FROM events_full WHERE type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name NOT IN ('', 'mcp-tool-call') AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: MCP tool calls (by tool)
panels.description: MCP tools/call spans captured by the LiteLLM OTel v2 logger (type=TOOL).

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Tool", count() AS "Calls", round(avg(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time))) AS "Avg ms", countIf(level = 'ERROR') AS "Errors" FROM events_full WHERE type = 'TOOL' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY Tool ORDER BY Calls DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT start_time AS "Time", provided_model_name AS "Model", name AS "Operation", dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time) AS "ms", usage_details['input'] AS "In", usage_details['output'] AS "Out", total_cost AS "Cost", level AS "Level", trace_id AS "trace_id" FROM events_full WHERE type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name NOT IN ('', 'mcp-tool-call') AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT start_time AS "Time", name AS "Tool", dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time) AS "ms", level AS "Level", trace_id AS "trace_id" FROM events_full WHERE type = 'TOOL' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS "traces" FROM events_full WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT provided_model_name AS "Model", count() AS "Calls", sum(usage_details['input']) AS "In tokens", sum(usage_details['output']) AS "Out tokens", round(sum(total_cost), 4) AS "USD" FROM events_full WHERE type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name NOT IN ('', 'mcp-tool-call') AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY Model ORDER BY Calls DESC
